Even under partially covered face conditions, FaceNet and SVM recorded 67% accuracy, which was significantly higher than Eigenface and SVM's 11% accuracy. The adaptability of FaceNet under different lighting conditions and visual challenges makes it a suitable deep-learning model for emotion recognition in online learning.

articleTitle: Comparative Performances of the Convolutional Neural Network based Transfer Learning Models for Classification of Dental Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The prevalence of large-scale dental disease in humans affects their health by making them unable to perform basic tasks with their mouth. Around 3.5 billion people worldwide are affected by dental and oral diseases, mostly in low- and middle-income countries. Due to the high cost of such a diagnosis and treatment, there are no adequate dental and oral health services. Utilizing rapid and dependable methods for early diagnosis of dental disease will be extremely beneficial in resolving this issue. An active area of research is identifying dental diseases from digital camera images. Various machine learning algorithms and the use of convolutional neural networks (CNN) have improved the accuracy of dental disease classification. A dental disease detection and classification system based on computer vision and dental disease photos will be crucial in this setting. Although a number of methods are currently used on an ad hoc basis to identify and classify dental diseases, there have been few systematic studies done to examine how well these methods work with real-world data on dental diseases. This study aim to assess the exhibitions of different CNN-based move learning structures, for example, the ResNet50V2, EfficientNetV0B0 and The Oral Disease Dataset, the Oral Infection Dataset, and the Teeth Dataset were the three publicly accessible databases on which the models were tested. Metrics performances such as, Accuracy, Review, F1 score and in general exactness were utilized to assess the end-product of the examination, which uncovered that ResNet50V2 showed the most elevated precision of 82%, 82.5% and 81.6% on the three datasets, separately, beating any remaining cutting edge models like EfficientNetV1B0 and EfficientNetV2B0.

articleTitle: Quality Measurement for Imperceptibility Watermarking Based on PSNR and SSIM using Walsh Hadamard Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The imperceptibility watermarking technique addresses the challenge of protecting digital content from unauthorized distribution while ensuring minimal impact on its visual quality. In this study, we propose a solution utilizing the Walsh-Hadamard Transform (WHT) to embed watermarks into digital images imperceptibly. WHT is a mathematical transformation that converts spatial domain data into the frequency domain, allowing for efficient watermark embedding while preserving the visual integrity of the original image. Our experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the WHT-based watermarking method, with the watermarked Lena image achieving the highest peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 58.712 dB and a structural similarity index (SSIM) of 0.99991 at an alpha value of 0.1, indicating minimal distortion and nearly perfect similarity with the original image. These findings highlight the robustness and reliability of our proposed technique in preserving image quality while embedding imperceptible watermarks. Moreover, our study contributes novel insights into the selection of alpha values for optimizing watermarking performance, as well as the potential applications of WHT-based watermarking in real-world scenarios such as copyright protection and intellectual property rights enforcement. For future research, further exploration into enhancing watermarking techniques and investigating novel applications of WHT-based watermarking in emerging technologies could lead to significant advancements in digital content protection and security.

articleTitle: Banking Meets Crypto: Integration Strategies in a Post-Demonetization Landscape
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Shift from traditional banking to cryptocurrencies has become significant in the rapidly changing digital landscape, particularly in a world undergoing demonetization trends. This transformation has significant consequences for financial stability, regulatory frameworks, and transaction security, which require prompt exploration and direction. Focusing on this, the current study delves into analyzing how the emergence of cryptocurrencies has elevated their significance and led to their substitution of the conventional paper currency system. By conducting empirical analysis, the study explores the safety of using digital currency and its potential as the next generation of transactions. Hence, extensive research is undertaken in this paper to provide a comprehensive understanding of the operational dynamics of cryptocurrencies during their implementation and the impact of demonetization on cryptocurrencies. Data has been gathered from a sample of 183 participants from different geographical regions in the Indian territory to analyze individuals' trust in cryptocurrencies when their usage remains unregulated. The survey also examined the participants' prognostications regarding the future of Bitcoin. However, the analysis of the increasing influence of cryptocurrencies lacks empirical evidence due to limitations in data availability. Moreover, the study contributes to the discussion on the safety and viability of digital currencies as the future of financial transactions.

articleTitle: Blockchain-based Framework for Securing and Enhancing Internet of Things Ecosystems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The rapid proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has amplified security concerns, making data protection and ensuring reliable device interactions paramount. This research investigates the potential of blockchain technology to address these security challenges and enhance the quality and functionality of IoT ecosystems. With its decentralized, immutable, and tamper-resistant nature, blockchain offers a robust solution by improving device authentication and authorization processes and ensuring data integrity. Utilizing a systematic literature review (SLR) methodology based on the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) framework, this paper analyzes current research to explore the benefits, challenges, and strategies for integrating blockchain into IoT systems. The findings demonstrate that blockchain can significantly enhance IoT security by reducing single points of failure and improving data integrity through its decentralized ledger system. Blockchain’s capabilities in managing device identities and automating interactions through smart contracts further strengthen IoT security frameworks. However, scalability, energy consumption, and integration complexity remain. Addressing these hurdles requires the development of more efficient consensus algorithms and seamless integration tools. This study provides valuable insights into the potential of blockchain to revolutionize IoT security, offering a pathway to creating a more secure and trusted IoT ecosystem. Future research should focus on scalability, energy-efficient consensus mechanisms, standardized integration protocols, and real-world case studies to refine blockchain solutions tailored for IoT environments, ensuring continued innovation and interdisciplinary collaboration between blockchain and IoT experts.

articleTitle: Machine Learning to Enhance Security in Cloud Computing: A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The usage and popularity of Cloud Computing is continuously growing. Cloud Computing can help users and businesses improve their productivity without worrying about maintaining the software. Moreover, Cloud Computing offers users scalability to meet their needs. Both users and businesses are investing in Cloud Computing. However, despite the advantages that Cloud Computing has, it has a weakness. Cloud Computing can be vulnerable to attack. The rise of the Cloud has led to several security issues which security is one of the important aspects of Cloud Computing to protect. Machine Learning comes as the solution to help prevent attacks in Cloud Computing. The objective of the paper is to review the security of Cloud Computing and analyze Machine Learning techniques that might have the potential to be used. This paper has reviewed 30 relevant studies, and the results are categorized into three main research areas which are Cloud security areas, the potential of ML, and ML techniques used. This study has defined Cloud security areas, with DDoS being the most mentioned. To help protect security, the chosen ML model will learn and be trained from historical anomaly data to prevent attacks. This study found 14 Machine Learning techniques discussed. It has been discovered that a Machine Learning model can be trained using historical anomaly data, which is one of the methods for helping in attack prevention. Additionally, it was discovered that Random Forest, KNN, and SVM are the most often used techniques for anomaly identification.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithms for Land Cover Classification Using Hybrid Remote Sensing and Spectral Indices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Accurate land cover classification is essential for effective environmental monitoring and resource management. This study aims to evaluate the performance of different machine learning algorithms for land cover classification using hybrid remote sensing data and spectral indices. By integrating data from Landsat 8 and Sentinel-2 satellites, this study utilizes the advantages of both sensors to improve classification accuracy. Spectral indices such as NDVI, MNDWI, NDMI, NDBI, and BSI were computed to enrich the feature set used for classification. A comprehensive dataset of training samples representing different land cover types - water, vegetation, built-up area, and bare land - was used to train and validate the machine learning model. Random Forest, Decision Tree, and Support Vector Machine were applied, and their performance was evaluated using metrics such as Overall Accuracy (OA), Kappa coefficient, and F1-score. The results show that integrating hybrid remote sensing data significantly improves the classification performance compared to single source data. Among the evaluated algorithms, Random Forest showed superior accuracy and robustness across different land cover types. This study highlights the importance of hybrid data and the combination of spectral indices in achieving high accuracy land cover classification and provides insights into the use of Random Forest for land cover classification.

articleTitle: Enhancing License Plate Recognition in Foggy Condition Base on Yolov8 and Dark Channel Prior
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach that combines the YOLOv8 object detection model with the Dark Channel Prior (DCP) algorithm to improve car license plate detection in foggy weather conditions. The proposed approach consists of two stages: the first stage is data preprocessing with the DCP approach, and the second stage is image preprocessing. The DCP model is trained to detect the license plates in the enhanced images, providing the final output of the proposed method. The experimental findings show that the suggested strategy significantly boosts detection accuracy and improves license plate visibility compared to conventional methods. Moreover, the integration of DCP with Yolov8 resulted in robust performance against fog, achieving an average precision of 0.975.

articleTitle: IndoBERT-based Indonesian Cyberbullying Detection with Multi-stage Labeling
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The problem of cyberbullying on social media in Indonesia needs to be addressed to protect users from irresponsible behavior. An efficient and effective text classification model is required to detect indications of bullying. This study collected a dataset from Twitter by searching for keywords related to body shaming. The dataset was labeled by using Large Language Model (LLM) and Vader Lexicon approaches for more accurate labeling. Due to the imbalanced dataset labeling, SMOTE was applied for oversampling the data to get a balanced dataset. The detection model was conducted by using IndoBERT. IndoBERT resulted in 96.7% accuracy with fine-tuning. The proposed model was then examined on real data based on a survey related to bullying sentences conducted with 20 students from Dian Nuswantoro University. The results showed that our models accurately predicted that these sentences contained elements of bullying.

articleTitle: Innovative Agricultural Solutions: Utilizing Machine Learning to Combat Rice Leaf Disease in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Advances in machine learning and image processing technology offer promising solutions for identifying diseases in rice plants. This study, which utilizes 80 data samples and trains on 20 data points from available datasets, proposes a novel approach using the Random Forest algorithm to efficiently classify leaf diseases. This method assists farmers, especially newcomers, in quickly identifying diseases via smartphone devices. By integrating various feature extraction techniques such as color, texture, and shape, the approach enhances accuracy in disease recognition, which is crucial for timely preventive measures. The process includes stages of data acquisition, preprocessing, feature extraction, and model evaluation to ensure robustness and reliability. By harnessing the power of machine learning, this research contributes to addressing the challenges faced in rural agriculture, aligning with Indonesia’s development goals outlined in the third Nawacita program. Through systematic analysis and evaluation, this approach highlights the potential of technology to empower farming communities, promote sustainable agricultural practices, and enhance food security in the region.

articleTitle: Harnessing technology for financial empowerment: A study on digitally driven financial inclusion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The primary purpose of this research is to assess the influence of digitization on financial inclusion in a representative/chosen sample of the population. A thorough analysis of respondents’ financial behavior, attitudes, and preferences elucidates how successful technological advancements are at fostering access to banking systems. The surveys were administered to a representative sample using structured questionnaires to acquire information concerning financial behavior, attitudes, and barriers to financial inclusion through technology. According to the results, large portions of the sample rely on digital means for payment. The findings also state their intention to use financial services if provided with a secure and reliable digitized mode for operating bank accounts. Intriguingly, the sample with a lesser formal education background has difficulty adjusting toward digitalized-based banking services and is willing to adapt if provided with adequate training and education. These findings highlight the issues of the geographical remoteness of the banks, which can be eliminated by prioritizing intervention based on technology. Furthermore, the study acknowledges the need for tailored products and services to address these impediments and strengthen financial inclusion through leveraging technological solutions. In summary, this investigation provides a prized insight into the impact of digitization on financial inclusion; it also provides practical guidelines that policymakers can adopt to facilitate technology-driven initiatives and make them successful.

articleTitle: Significance of Big Data Analytics and The Internet of Things Aspects in Sustainability: A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: With an emphasis on supply chain management and agriculture, this study investigates how Big Data Analytics (BDA) and the Internet of Things (IoT) affect sustainability in a variety of industries. This study aims to evaluate how BDA and IoT integration might improve corporate effectiveness and sustainability practices. We incorporate qualitative and quantitative data to assess how well these technologies promote sustainable practices, using the Sustainable Supply Chain Management-IRIS paradigm. According to our research, integrating BDA with IoT greatly increases resource management, stimulates better decision-making, decreases environmental impact, and increases organizational sustainability and efficiency. Precision farming and the Internet of Things in agriculture increase yields while consuming less resources. These technologies improve the resilience and efficiency of supply chains' operations. According to our study's findings, IoT and BDA are revolutionary technologies that have the potential to significantly advance sustainability objectives across a range of industries, promoting their wider use for a sustainable future.

articleTitle: Transitioning to E-Health Platforms for Mental Wellness: The Need for Data-Driven Contemporary Solutions for Professionals
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: In the backdrop of the unprecedented challenges brought about by the COVID-19 pandemic, the mental health of individuals has become a critical issue. This paper aims to highlight the need to provide traction to e-health apps considering the constraints of traditional methods of mental wellness. The authors conducted a primary research study by conducting semi-structured interviews focusing on users of mental health apps. 70 working professionals who were mental health app users in the Special Economic Zones (SEZ) of Pune city in Maharashtra, India, were selected using a purposive sampling technique. By conducting semi-structured interviews, we explore the opinions and effectiveness of mental health apps in promoting employee well-being during the post-pandemic period. Our study reveals detailed insights into how these apps have helped users manage stress, anxiety, and despair while pointing out limitations and areas for improvement. By highlighting the opinions of app users, this research adds to our knowledge of how virtual interventions can promote mental health even in a post-crisis period. Based on the findings of this study, a model is proposed for leveraging the digitally enabled e-health platform to promote the mental wellness of employees.

articleTitle: The Evolution of Omnichannel in Digital Era: A Bibliometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: This study aims to investigate the evolution of omnichannel over time in research using bibliometric analysis. Initially, a collection of 1167 publications specifically pertaining to the field of omnichannel was gathered from the Scopus database between 2010 and 2023. Using theme analysis, concurrence analysis, and timeline analysis of authors' keywords, this study examined the core problems and traits of omnichannel research, including the annual contribution of publication, hot in the press, and foci. Second, to present who receives significant attention in omnichannel research, prolific objects such as journals, authors, institutions, countries, regions, and corresponding pivotal cooperative relationship mapping were used. Finally, the burst detection analysis of cited authors, journals, and references was presented after the citation structures of authors and journals were examined. Ultimately, the difficulties and prospects for future growth are explored in more detail by fusing the analysis findings with the existing financial landscape. The results of this bibliometric analysis showed that the field of omnichannel science is active and has room for more scientific advancement. It also showed a growing trend of annual publications, a shift in focus towards financial inclusion, a preponderance of Chinese authors, and an increasing number of international collaborations and publications from various sources. In light of this, this thorough analysis of the omnichannel documents not only summarizes the features and directions of current research, but also assists academics in identifying the best place to begin their investigation and carry out in-depth research.

articleTitle: From Automation to Optimization: Boosting Employee Efficiency and Engagement for Contemporary Human Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: With the advancement of technology, the usage of artificial Intelligence (AI) and its impact is evident across different business verticals. Human Resource Management is one of them. Implementation of AI is across industries in multiple capacities for its efficacy and productivity. In this study, authors attempt to identify the impact of AI across HRM through automated and optimised processes, such as automated resume screening, customised training and development programmes based on employee learning history, etc., that lead to personalised employee development. All this can be achieved only with the help of AI intervention. Due to the data-driven decision-making approach, HR managers can make informed decisions that enhance employee efficiency and productivity. By leveraging the power of AI and IoT across HRM functions, organisations can enhance their employee performance (EP) and employee engagement (EE), and ultimately, this will result in enhanced overall efficiency for the organisation. The authors also proposed a model that can be adopted across the HR department to enhance EP and EE. To conduct this study, the authors have selected 29 HR professionals from Bengaluru, India. Responses were obtained through a semi-structured interview method; samples were collected by purposive sampling method. Factors were analysed further using thematic analysis, and a model was proposed that can be adopted across industry and academia to enhance EE and EP.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and IndoBERT Models Using SPAMID-PAIR Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Spam comments on social media platforms like Instagram pose a significant challenge, disrupting genuine user interactions. This research investigates and compares the effectiveness of machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), and IndoBERT models for detecting spam comments on Instagram using the SPAMID-Pair dataset. The central question addressed is how different models perform in classifying spam comments in the Indonesian language, particularly considering contextual relationships between comments and posts. Previous studies have explored various ML and DL models for spam detection, often neglecting the context provided by posts. This research aims to fill this gap by using a dataset that includes both comments and their corresponding posts, highlighting the importance of contextual analysis in improving spam detection accuracy. The methodology involved dataset preparation, preprocessing, data undersampling, and applying various ML, DL, and IndoBERT models. Results indicate that LightGBM, particularly with FastText and BERT embeddings, achieved high accuracy and F1 scores. Deep learning models like BiLSTM, CNN, and Transformer also demonstrated strong performance, with the IndoBERT-large-p1 model outperforming all. This study underscores the significance of advanced NLP techniques and contextual analysis in enhancing spam detection on social media platforms.

articleTitle: Advanced Dehazing of Single Satellite Imagery Using Enhanced Dark Channel Prior and Refined Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Haze in photography reduces image contrast and light for distant subjects, with light dispersion by haze particles causing significant issues that affect image reliability in scenarios such as disaster assessments. Removing haze is crucial in various fields, including photography and computer vision applications. The Dark Channel Prior (DCP) method is commonly used for haze removal in single satellite images. Building on the DCP method, several enhancements have been proposed, such as the Multi-Scale Dehazing Network (MSDN), Color Attenuation Prior (CAP), CAP-Haze-Lines (CAP-HL), and DCP-Gamma Correction. This research focuses on integrating multiple techniques to mitigate haze effects in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery sourced from the Satehaze1k dataset. The proposed method begins with dark channel extraction, followed by adaptive atmospheric light estimation based on the brightest pixels in the dark channel. Transmission map estimation leverages these dark channels, and guided filters refine the transmission map. A Multi-Scale Dehazing technique is applied to address varying haze levels. Finally, the image reconstruction process utilizes atmospheric light and transmission maps, with additional RGB reduction and level shift techniques to minimize red color fluctuations. Integrating multiple dehazing techniques is crucial for superior image restoration in challenging haze conditions. The proposed approach not only enhances image quality but also balances visual improvement and processing time, making it a robust solution for single image dehazing in satellite imagery.

articleTitle: The Role of Augmented Reality (AR) in Retail Marketing: Enhancing Customer Engagement and In-store Experiences
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Outreach of Augmented Reality or AR gets to the very edge of the advances of technologies that aim to change shopping rooms. This AR technology bridges the digital and physical worlds, providing shoppers with the exciting interactivity of a multimedia experience. It also lets shoppers engage with a product or brand deeper, leads to an increase in the rich experience of the store, and ultimately results in an increase in sales. This research undertakes a detailed examination of AR’s fundamental use for retail marketing, which lies in its unique ability to improve customer engagement and boost the quality of their in-store shopping experiences. The study will start with a complete outline in which AR technology will be given a thorough briefing covering its multiple applications that can transform the retail industry. Specific examples are given, including various cases in which the mentioned AR technologies are being used by innovative retailers to improve their customer experience.

articleTitle: Identifying Sentiment in User Reviews of Get Contact Application using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Analyzing user feedback on application updates may introduce a time-consuming task for the developers, since the task usually done manually. On the other hand, when users adjusting to these updates, it may elicit a range of feedbacks, both in favor and against the updates that have been implemented. Analyzing unfavorable reviews can be strategically utilized to enhance the app. Therefore, it is necessary to employ a straightforward, efficient, and accurate approach in analyzing user feedback. A potential approach is sentiment analysis, which can produce pertinent data by conducting multiple algorithmic tests. This study demonstrates the application of Natural Language Processing (NLP) in identifying sentiment in user feedbacks of Get Contact on Playstore. NLP is chosen for its remarkable proficiency in Sentiment analysis. The study involves multiple sequential steps: data collection, labeling, pre-processing, TF-IDF analysis, algorithm testing, result discussion, and summary. The examined algorithms include Naive Bayes, Deep Learning, Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbor, and Decision Tree. Precision is chosen as the primary metric for evaluation, since it allows for more accurate predictions on bad reviews. The results indicate that the Naive Bayes approach fared better than the other algorithms in terms of precision and accuracy.

articleTitle: Exploring the Impact of Gamification to Perceived Enjoyment and Customer Personalized Experience to Increasing Customer Satisfaction and Customer Loyalty
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: In the realm of marketing, there has been significant emphasis on gamification, perceived enjoyment, and personalized customer experience for enhancing customer loyalty and satisfaction. The research aims to investigate how gamification influences perceived enjoyment and personalized customer experience to bolster customer satisfaction and loyalty. This study uses a correlation-based cross-sectional approach with 200 participants as the sample. The data obtained will be assessed using Smart-PLS (Partial Least Square) for Structural Equation Modeling (SEM). The findings show that gamification has a positive impact on the enjoyment perspective, as well as on customer personalized experience and satisfaction. Additionally, perceived enjoyment and personalized customer experience are found to affect costumer satisfaction which in turn has an impact on customer loyalty. This study offers valuable insights into leveraging gamification, perceived enjoyment, and personalized customer experience to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty.

articleTitle: Android Malware Detection using Fast Correlation Based Filter and Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Malware analysts have faced several difficulties in the past few years due to the rapid growth of Android malware. This surge in Android malware not only threatens the security and privacy of users but also undermines the integrity of the Android ecosystem. As cybercriminals get more advanced, the methods for detecting and dealing with malware need to grow more sophisticated. To find the best combination for identifying Android malware, this study compares different machine learning algorithms and feature selection techniques. The dataset used in this research is the CICMaldroid2020 dataset. The results indicate that the combination of the Fast Correlation-Based Filter feature selection method and the Random Forest algorithm achieved the highest performance, with both accuracy and F1-Score at 92.5%.

articleTitle: Systematic Literature Review of Software Effort Estimation : Research Trends, Methods, and Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Without sufficient effort, the development of a software project will be hindered and may even significantly fail, thus jeopardizing the quality of the software developers. Therefore, Software Effort Estimation (SEE) is a crucial activity in software engineering. One of the most important tasks in software engineering is software effort estimation (SEE). SEE has been the subject of several investigations, which have produced a substantial body of new literature quickly. Determining the primary research topics is essential to get a thorough grasp of the frameworks and trends in Software Effort Estimation (SEE) research today. A systematic literature review (SLR) was utilized in this study as an all-encompassing method to identify and examine every significant research issue in this field. Three research topics were identified from 58 journals, including algorithmic techniques, machine learning implementation, and dataset analysis. The algorithmic techniques and machine learning approaches are the most frequently discussed topics.

articleTitle: Enhancing Machine Learning Algorithms Using Recursive Feature Elimination For Student Performance Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Prediction systems for students' performance are crucial in improving educational outcomes in higher education institutions. Big data can be sourced from various channels, such as examination centers, academic systems, registration departments, and e-learning platforms. Extracting meaningful insights from educational data is challenging, necessitating data dimensionality reduction. This study introduces an enhanced recursive feature elimination (RFE) algorithm as a wrapper feature selection technique. We adopt machine learning by combining the proposed RFE with five different classifiers, including Gradient Boosting Classifier (GB), Random Forest Classifier (RF), Support Vector Classifier (SVC), K-Neighbors Classifier (KNN), and Decision Tree Classifier (DT). The dataset was originally intended to influence factors in dropout students, and it has 329 records and 9 features. The AUC score improved by 8% compared to the model tested without the proposed feature selection method by testing the proposed methodology with the Decision Tree Classifier. Educators and academic institutions can utilize this information to develop targeted intervention strategies, tailored learning experiences, and personalized recommendations for students, ultimately promoting a more effective learning environment and improving overall educational outcomes.

articleTitle: Identification of Ablaut and Rhyme Reduplications Using Fuzzy Inference System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Ablaut reduplication involves changing vowels, such as sing-song and chit-chat, while rhyme reduplications involve changing consonants such as hurly-burly. The occurrence of vowels in such reduplications follows certain patterns. To develop a fuzzy inference system that can predict the type of reduplications based on the phonetic patterns, this study examines the frequency of various phonetic patterns in the reduplications. This research used a quantitative design with statistical calculations and computer programming. The data were 150 samples reduplications, collected from textbooks, websites, and various internet sources. The samples were taken as isolated words, not in contexts (within sentences) as the meanings of the reduplications were not used as a variable in this research. The data were analyzed using chi-square for frequency analysis and a fuzzy inference system for the prediction. The results indicated a significant correlation between the frequency of occurrence and the type of reduplication. Moreover, rhyme reduplications have significantly more phonetic patterns than ablaut reduplications. Meanwhile, the system produces 92.9% accuracy in identifying the correct type of reduplication, and 80% accuracy in identifying whether an English word is a reduplication. This study implies a growing need for the application of computational linguistics in the future, that language can be studied from different perspectives, especially today, where there is a growing need for better natural language processing capabilities in computing.

articleTitle: Site Selection with Fuzzy DEMATEL for a Post-Earthquake Temporary Shelter in Türkiye
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Temporary shelter areas established after an earthquake to swiftly build safe living spaces for meeting the urgent housing needs of earthquake victims. Given Türkiye's status as an earthquake-prone country, defining the standards for the establishment and maintenance of these temporary shelter areas is of great importance since they are restoring social order and ensuring people to feel safe after an earthquake. This study identifies and analyzes the evaluation criteria that temporary shelter areas should possess and investigates the causal relationships between them. For this purpose, expert opinions are gathered, and given the inherent uncertainty in human judgment fuzzy logic is incorporated. Hence, to analyze the causal relationships between the criteria, fuzzy DEMATEL method is applied, which is a powerful technique for problem evaluation, allowing unprecise definition of interconnections within a structural model. The application results suggest the criteria related with the social dimension as the most influential.

articleTitle: Continuity Plan for a Gamified System which Enhance Customer Service Advisor Training in Peru using ITIL 4
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: In the Peruvian financial sector, the quality of customer service and the training of advisors are essential. If a gamified system is used, it can face failures or disasters that affect its availability, and recent studies indicate a lack of understanding and integration of continuity plans. This study proposes a model to implement a continuity plan for a gamified training system for advisors, utilizing ITIL V4 practices. It implemented the best practices of ITIL 4: (1) incident management, (2) problem management, (3) change management, (4) service level management, (5) security management, and (6) availability management. In (1) incidents are resolved quickly and effectively; in (2) the cause of the incident is investigated and the impact of the problem is mitigated; in (3) changes with the greatest benefit and least risk are maximized; in (4) service contracts establish minimum availability levels; in (5) company activities are monitored to protect the most important data; in (6) the maximum availability of the system is ensured. Additionally, a record and management system was implemented, and incidents were prioritized based on their urgency and impact. The results indicated that, after a comparative evaluation, Jira stands out for its intelligent analysis capabilities and automated incident comparison. Furthermore, the implementation of this continuity plan improves operational resilience and customer confidence, ensuring the quality and availability of the service in a market highly dependent on reliable information systems.

articleTitle: Comparison Performance of SVM, Naïve Bayes and XGBoost Classifier on Climate Change Issue
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: A long-term shift in the weather patterns from tropical to polar regions is called climate change. This is a worldwide threat that is beginning to materialize and exerting pressure on numerous industries. One step in reducing the effects of climate change is measuring public opinion. Every day, thousands of people share thoughts via tweets on the well-known microblogging platform namely Twitter. Twitter, now it’s famous as X, is a fantastic resource for information about public opinion and perceived issue risk. One of the hot topics being discussed on Twitter is climate change. Climate change is one of the well-known and quickly expanding topics of study in sentiment analysis within natural language processing (NLP) and text classification. In this study, the Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naïve Bayes (NB), and XGBoost (XGB) classifier algorithms were used to examine attitudes about the climate change issue. Data obtained from Kaggle was divided into 4 sentiments, namely News, Pro, Neutral and Anti. Dataset was divided into 80% as training data and 20% as testing data. With an accuracy of 73.32%, the SVM classifier beat the NB and XGB classifier in the classification. Hyperparameter was used to optimize the accuracy, and the result increased for 3% in SVM method.

articleTitle: Art in the Era of Algorithms: Is Generative AI a Friend or Foe for 2D Artists?
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: This research investigates the transformative impact of AI technologies such as DALL-E, ChatGPT, and other generative AI tools on the arts, particularly focusing on their implications for 2D artwork. These advancements have democratized the creation of 2D art, making it more accessible, but they have also raised concerns about the value of original talent and the potential impact on careers in the arts. The study employs the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) to evaluate the acceptance and impact of generative AI among individuals in creative fields, including students, lecturers, and professionals. Data collected from 127 respondents through structured surveys indicate high levels of engagement with generative AI, reflecting significant curiosity and usage rates. Analysis using SmartPLS 4.0 Tools validated the initial research model, demonstrating that generative AI significantly influences perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, and behavioral intention in 2D art creation. These findings underscore the critical need to consider AI's evolving role in the arts, its impact on perceptions of creativity and talent, and its broader implications for the creative industry. The study tested seven hypotheses, with six accepted and one rejected. This indicates that while factors like user computer self-efficacy and quality information significantly influence the perceived usefulness and ease of use of generative AI, ease of use alone does not necessarily lead to a positive attitude towards its use. However, perceived usefulness significantly contributes to a positive attitude towards using generative AI. Additionally, a positive attitude towards generative AI influences the behavioral intention to use it, thereby enhancing skills and providing inspiration for creating artwork.

articleTitle: Exploring Algorithmic Approaches for Emotion Classification in Text
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The classification of emotions in text is a rapidly growing field with significant applications, including sentiment analysis and social media monitoring. However, achieving high accuracy in emotion classification remains a challenge. This research aims to explore algorithmic approaches for emotion classification using the ISEAR dataset, which includes various emotions such as joy, fear, anger, sadness, disgust, shame, and guilt. Researchers employ machine learning techniques such as Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, and Support Vector Machines (SVM), and use data augmentation techniques to improve model performance. Augmentation methods, including synonym replacement and random embedding, are used to increase the diversity of the training data. The dataset is divided into training and testing sets with a ratio of 80:20. The results show that Random Forest excels with the highest score on all performance metrics: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F1-Score of 92% each. SVM also shows good performance, especially in Recall, with a score of 79%. Logistic Regression has stable performance across all metrics with scores of 76%. The Naive Bayes model demonstrates the poorest performance, achieving an accuracy rate of 69%, precision rate of 75%, recall rate of 69%, and F1-Score of 69%. In conclusion, data augmentation techniques significantly enhance model performance, with the Random Forest model demonstrating the highest efficiency in emotion classification in this study.

articleTitle: A Chaotic Image Encryption Based on Random Noise and Arnold Cat Maps
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The increasing prevalence of data theft incidents, particularly involving sensitive images like identification documents or medical records, poses significant risks to individuals and organizations. To mitigate these risks, employing robust image encryption techniques is crucial. This study proposes a solution whereby strong encryption methods, including random noise based on ensemble Gaussian and salt and pepper techniques, along with the Arnold Cat Map (ACM), are applied to protect image data. The effectiveness of this approach is demonstrated through measurements of Mean Squared Error (MSE), Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), Unified Average Changing Intensity (UACI), and Number of Pixel Change Rate (NPCR). Results indicate a notable increase in UACI values from the Random Noise to the Proposed Encryption stage, suggesting heightened security against unauthorized access. Specifically, for the Lena image, the MSE and PSNR at the Random Noise stage are (7.778, 22.131 dB), at the Image Scrambling stage are (19.111, 9.86 dB), and at the Proposed Encryption stage are (33.211, 4.922 dB). Similarly, for the Peppers image, the MSE and PSNR at the Random Noise stage are (9.898, 18.131 dB), at the Image Scrambling stage are (22.776, 9.311 dB), and at the Proposed Encryption stage are (36.854, 4.944 dB). Additionally, for the Baboon image, the MSE and PSNR at the Random Noise stage are (9.297, 19.131 dB), at the Image Scrambling stage are (22.41, 9.722 dB), and at the Proposed Encryption stage are (37.812, 4.989 dB). NPCR values remain consistently high across all encryption stages and images, indicating reliable pixel change detection. For future research, exploring advanced encryption algorithms and hybrid approaches could further enhance image security and foster innovation in data protection methods.

articleTitle: Role of Teachers in Integrating AI-based Chatbots in School Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The study investigates the use of AI-based chatbots in school education in India. It attempts to understand the role of the teachers as enablers of such technology. Also, the research attempts to explain the process behind the AI-based chatbots simply, which is necessary for teachers to understand, as they must use such technology effectively in the classroom. We have also done a thorough bibliometric analysis to gauge past research work done in this field. This study used primary and secondary sources to draw references concerning using AI-based chatbots in rural areas of India. In this study, the perceived value of AI-based chatbots for instructors was ascertained using thematic analysis based on semi-structured interviews of expert teachers on specific ensuing themes to understand the teacher’s perspective, which is essential for further emancipation of the technology amongst the students.

articleTitle: Instagram Augmented Reality Marketing in Boosting Brand Awareness and e-WOM in the Indonesian Bottled Tea Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: This study explores the efficacy of Instagram's augmented reality (AR) features in enhancing brand awareness and electronic word-of-mouth (e-WOM) within Indonesia's bottled tea industry. The research uses a cross-sectional survey and partial least square structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) to focus on how AR can transform consumer engagement and interaction on social media platforms. Findings from a sample of 260 bottled tea consumers in Greater Jakarta indicate that AR significantly enhances brand awareness, substantially influencing e-WOM. The integration of AR into Instagram marketing not only captivates and engages users but also fosters stronger consumer-brand relationships and promotes brand loyalty through interactive and immersive digital experiences. The study’s implications underscore AR's role in revolutionising marketing strategies by providing immersive experiences that are shown to increase brand visibility and influence purchasing decisions. Limitations and future research directions are discussed, highlighting the potential for broader applications of AR in different market segments and its impact on various consumer demographics.

articleTitle: Unveiling the impact of Live-Stream Commerce (LSC) Customer Satisfaction in Online SMEs towards minimizing Cart Abandonment Rate (CAR)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: There is a massive surge in the popularity of live streaming in general. Because these online discussions are live, anyone may participate in real-time communication. This benefits online businesses, both small and medium-sized, that use live streaming to market their goods and answer questions from potential clients. These days, many online businesses deal with the issue of online shopping cart abandonment, defined as when a consumer adds things to their virtual shopping carts but subsequently decides not to buy part or all of them. A literature study was conducted using studies on the Live-Stream Commerce Cart Abandonment Rate that supports the research. The variables of this research are Trust, Perceived Risk, Perceived Cost, Social Presence, and Cart Abandonment. The data collection method utilized by the author was purposive sampling in conjunction with quantitative research. One non-random sampling technique is purposeful sampling, in which the researcher selects samples based on characteristics that align with the study's goals and are anticipated to answer research questions. Indonesian Citizens made up the study's population. In this investigation, 521 samples were used, and the process took one month, from April to May 2024. Questionnaires and observations were used to obtain the data. Unlike promotions, discounts, and free shipping, buyers' primary concerns appear to be price. If retailers do not respond to questions, they have regarding the goods they are about to buy in a friendly and cordial manner, customers are more likely to give up on their shopping carts.

articleTitle: A Study on Students’ Satisfaction toward MOOCs Concerning Management Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: This study involves understanding students’ satisfaction towards Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) provided by various private platforms like Coursera and Udemy. The students are taken from management backgrounds. This study aims to understand the gaps in service design and delivery. This study found that using a proper grading system in proctor mode improves satisfaction. Apart from that, just completion of MOOC does not guarantee the improvement in the technical competency of the student and strict course completion does not lead to timely course completion. The researcher also studied the other factors that affect satisfaction levels like timely student-instructor interaction, the cost-effectiveness of the course, occupation-oriented course content, concise and just-in-time learning, prompt availability of technical support and concluded that all of these factors could be combined into one single factor likely to be called as Service quality. The data was analyzed using correlation, regression chi-square, and exploratory factor analysis.

articleTitle: Analysis Performance of Optimization Method in ResNet50 for Cotton Leaf Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Cotton plants are a large commodity. The cotton crop is one of the leading crops grown in several countries around the world, so in this case, crop loss leads to yield loss. There are various reasons for crop loss, but one of them is leaf disease. Therefore, disease classification was considered in this study. We analyze the performance of four optimization techniques in a simple transfer learning with the ResNet50 architecture. The investigated techniques are the Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), Root Mean Square Propagation (RMSprop), Adaptive Moment Estimation (Adam), and Adaptive moment estimation Extension based on infinity norm (Adamax). We train the model and calculate the accuracy rate for each optimizer using publicly available cotton leaf disease datasets. The results obtained from the experiment show that Adamax achieved better performance across the other three optimization techniques. Accuracy, accuracy, recall, and f1-score obtained using the Adamax optimizer are 100%, respectively.

articleTitle: A Risk Assessment Model for Supply Chain Using a Hybrid Fault Tree Analysis and Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The development of Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) models needs to be enhanced to reduce subjectivity in determining weights and parameters, address the need for extensive data, and minimize computational complexity. This research aims to develop an SCRM model using the Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) and Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) methods, implemented as an algorithm in small to medium-sized metal manufacturing enterprises in Indonesia. The research proceeded through two main stages: risk identification and risk assessment. Based on the literature review and expert group discussions, eleven relevant supply chain risks were identified. These risks were then classified into three categories: supply risks (S), manufacturing risks (M), and distribution risks (D). Implementing the model in the manufacturing company revealed that errors in product handling during the production process (M<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>) had the highest risk value. This assessment was based on predetermined probability and impact scores. Such critical risks require immediate mitigation measures. Based on these findings, the FTA and AHP model, in its algorithmic form, has proven effective as a risk assessment technique and can be replicated by practitioners in other manufacturing industries.

articleTitle: Edible and Poisonous Mushroom Classification using Convolution Neural Network (CNN)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Indonesia is geographically located on the equator which makes it a tropical country, so it has biodiversity, one of which is mushrooms. The activity of clearing wild mushrooms is the daily life of the Indonesian people. However, this activity is at risk due to ignorance or inaccuracy in seeing the types of poisonous mushrooms that are identical to edible mushrooms. To overcome this problem, several researchers have used machine learning algorithms to help classify types of edible mushrooms and types of poisonous mushrooms. The research methodology uses the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) method, then the data that has been collected requires preprocessing before being used in the CNN model. These steps can include resizing images to have uniform sizes, normalizing pixel intensities, as well as dividing the dataset into subsets for training, validation, and testing. This data set was obtained from Kaggle, which contains various images of mushrooms with labels indicating whether they are edible or poisonous. By using data sets from these various sources, CNN models can be better trained to recognize different types of fungi based on their visual characteristics. The combination of data from these sources ensures that the model has high accuracy in classifying edible and poisonous mushrooms. Based on the experimental results, the RestNet50 model shows better performance compared to other models with an accuracy value of 100%. Including the prediction results, the ResNet50 model gives good prediction results with the highest probability value of 95.64% and is consistently using both transfer learning and fine-tuning techniques, including the use of data balance and imbalance data. Whereas the MobileNetV2 model shows better results when using fine-tuning techniques.

articleTitle: ChatGPT and Local Wisdom: An Exploratory Study of AI-assisted Ethnoscience Lesson Plan
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: ChatGPT is an artificial intelligence generative tool that has many uses, especially in the field of writing. In education, technology can be applied in many ways, one of which is in creating a good learning design. This research aims to explore the advantages and limitations of ChatGPT in designing ethnoscience-based learning and how this technology can integrate local wisdom in the science curriculum. Using a qualitative approach, this research examines how ChatGPT can assist teachers in creating engaging and meaningful lesson designs for students, while maintaining local and cultural excellence. The results show that ChatGPT has great potential in supporting character education and learning quality through the integration of technology and local wisdom. However, it requires a deep understanding of local culture and the ability to integrate it with the existing curriculum.

articleTitle: New E-Marketing Strategies Through Big Data Optimization in Fisheries MSMEs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The shift towards digitalization in recent times has significantly impacted the maritime and fisheries sector, particularly Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs), as they navigate through post-pandemic market challenges. This study investigates the utilization of big data to enhance the marketing efficacy of MSMEs in the fisheries industry. Employing a quantitative approach, the research engaged with over 510 respondents from fisheries MSMEs, utilizing purposive sampling. The findings indicate that new e-marketing strategy through big data optimization proves effective in enhancing sales, brand awareness, and customer retention, with a key emphasis on sustainability. Furthermore, responsiveness to market dynamics and the incorporation of e-marketing strategy within the Blue Economy are suggested as innovative approaches to address post-pandemic market shifts.

articleTitle: Navigating E-Business in Over-the-Top (OTT) Services: Exploring the Importance of Customer Experience (CX)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The dynamics of the e-business landscape are pivotal to the development of OTT services for society. As the entertainment industry transitions towards internet-based systems and services, operational optimization and effective business expansion are becoming more achievable. OTT services, a type of e-business product, are experiencing dynamic growth in response to the increasing demand for digital content. Customer experience (CX) is a crucial factor that influences the success and continuity of OTT services. This research investigates the significance of customer experience in e-business for over-the-top (OTT) services. A Systematic Literature Review (SLR) was conducted, analyzing 68 relevant articles published between 2019 and 2023, to provide a comprehensive understanding of OTT services in e-business. The study identifies key factors that contribute positively to customer experience in OTT services and discusses the challenges and opportunities for the successful implementation of customer experience strategies in these services. Quantitative data from the reviewed literature indicates that OTT services focusing on personalization, content variety, and accessibility experience a 30% higher customer satisfaction rate compared to those that do not. Additionally, services that effectively address technical issues and subscription fatigue report a 25% increase in user retention..

articleTitle: Implementation of Convolutional Neural Network Based on InceptionV3 to Classify Guava Quality
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Guava, a significant commodity in the market, has traditionally relied on farmers to sort it manually. The advancement of technology, one of which is machine learning, has offered a promising solution to automate this task through image classification. This study, evaluating the effectiveness and performance of the Convolutional Neural Network method employing the InceptionV3 transfer learning architecture to classify guava quality, was conducted with meticulous attention to detail. The datasets, comprising 166 images categorized as Super Class, A Class, B Class, and Reject Class, were used to conduct experiments on the dataset split ratios and hyperparameter tuning to achieve optimal performance. In this study, using a 0.00005 learning rate, 200 epochs, and an 8:2 train-test split ratio, 15% of the training data was allocated for validation, resulting in machine-learning models with a testing accuracy of 94.11%. We believe that this study's results can help farmers automate guava fruit sorting.

articleTitle: Exploring the Impact of Technostress on Millennial Work-Life Balance in Digital Work: The Mediating Role of Work Well-Being
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Technostress is the latest challenge for companies with the massive use of technology in their work. This research aims to determine the influence of technostress and family-friendly policies on work-life balance with the mediating role of work well-being. This study employed the explanatory type of research methodology. Primary data was collected from 244 career couple of millennial employees in manufacturing companies in Indonesia. Smart PLS software was used to perform partial least squares structural equation modeling. The study's findings suggest that work well-being has a significant effect in mediating the relationship between technostress and family-friendly policies on work-life balance. This study presents new findings that are considered relevant to the condition of the Indonesian workforce, which is dominated by the millennial generation. This research is particularly urgent due to the significant increase in the use of technology accelerated by the COVID-19 pandemic. Millennials, who use technology extensively, are particularly vulnerable to higher levels of IT stress compared to other generations. The increasing reliance on digital technologies exacerbates technostress, highlighting the need for more research to understand and mitigate its impact. Companies need to address technostress to improve mental health, job satisfaction, and overall well-being and can implement a sustainable digitalization strategy that prioritizes employee health and work-life balance.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Machine Learning Classifiers in Named Entity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Named Entity Recognition (NER) is crucial for organizing unstructured text data by detecting essential features such as names, locations, and organizations. This study provides a comprehensive evaluation of four machine learning classifiers: Conditional Random Fields (CRF), Logistic Regression (LR), Naive Bayes (NB), and Support Vector Machines (SVM). The performance of these models is assessed using the CoNLL-2003 dataset, which is widely recognized for its extensive coverage and intricate structure. The evaluation is based on precision, recall, and overall F1 scores. The results highlight the exceptional performance of the SVM model, which achieved the best F1 score of 89.91%, demonstrating its flexibility in accurately detecting entities. LR showed high effectiveness, especially when there were obvious differences between classes, as indicated by an F1 score of 87.82%. Although CRF and NB had lower performance scores, they showed clear advantages in situations requiring contextual analysis of interaction between classes. This work provides valuable insights for selecting the appropriate classifier for NER tasks to improve the accuracy and efficiency of information retrieval systems.

articleTitle: Influencer Marketing Redefined: The Era of AI-Powered Personalization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) with social media algorithms is pivotal in optimizing content visibility and engagement across platforms. By leveraging AI's analytical power, marketers can predict which content will perform best, aligning campaigns with audience preferences and boosting success rates. This study investigates the impact of AI-driven personalized content on customer engagement and purchase intentions in the marketing industry. We examined how AI-driven personalization maximizes customer engagement and influences purchasing behavior through surveys administered to 322 followers who consume social media content and have purchased products through that content or social media influencers. The research highlights the positive interactions between influencers and followers, demonstrating the significant impact of tailored content on brand awareness and consumer decision-making. These insights are valuable for influencers, marketers, and customers. Influencers can refine their content strategies to engage their audience better, resulting in stronger follower relationships and increased influence. Marketers gain a deeper understanding of how AI personalization can enhance campaign effectiveness, leading to higher customer engagement and sales. Customers benefit from more relevant and appealing content, improving their overall experience and satisfaction. The findings of the study could be utilized by marketers to improve influencer campaigns, elevate customer engagement, and bolster brand awareness, driving sales in the digital marketing environment.
